title: More Than a Dancer
story:
For many people, j-hope first became known as BTS's outstanding dancer. But dance was never the only way he wanted to express himself. He had stories to tell, thoughts to share, and a musical identity he wanted the world to discover.

FINDING HIS VOICE AS AN ARTIST

Long before releasing his first mixtape, he had already been developing as a rapper and songwriter. His early solo tracks, including **1 VERSE**, gave listeners a glimpse into his personal style and the ideas he was exploring as an artist.

On **March 2, 2018**, j-hope released his first solo mixtape, **Hope World**. It was a major milestone: a project through which he could introduce himself not only as a member of BTS, but as an individual artist with his own musical world.

In an interview with **TIME**, he described the mixtape as his calling card to the world. He explained that he wanted to tell his own story through music, just as RM and SUGA had done with their earlier mixtapes. Their projects inspired him to share his own perspective and explore the sounds that felt right to him.

SEVEN TRACKS, SEVEN SIDES OF HIS WORLD

**Hope World** contains seven tracks, each revealing a different side of his personality and creative interests. The title track invites listeners into his imaginative world, while **P.O.P (Piece of Peace) Pt. 1** expresses his wish to give people strength and comfort. **Daydream** explores the private wishes and desires he sometimes has to keep to himself as a public figure. **Base Line** reflects on his essence and the foundations of his identity. **HANGSANG** celebrates his pride in BTS, while **Airplane** captures the feeling of realizing that a childhood dream has come true. The mixtape closes with **Blue Side (Outro)**, a quieter and more nostalgic reflection.

A WORLD OF HIS OWN

j-hope was involved in writing and producing the project, shaping its sound with a mix of hip-hop, rap, electronic and other musical influences. He did not want to limit himself to one style. Instead, he followed the sounds and ideas that inspired him.

The release was also a success beyond the artistic experience. **Hope World** reached No. 1 on the iTunes albums chart in **63 countries**, showing how many listeners around the world were ready to enter his musical world.

With this mixtape, j-hope proved that his creativity could not be defined by one role. He was a dancer, yes - but also a rapper, songwriter, producer, and an artist with a story of his own.

And **Hope World** was only the beginning.
